verdict.rationale: cubic runs several autonomous background behaviors that users can switch on. These include automatic review of every new PR, auto-fix across every review, auto-approval of low-risk PRs, auto-resolution of fixed threads, and automatic issue-requirement analysis, all configurable via cubic.yaml. However, these are fixed toggles inside the code-review workflow, not user-defined automations with their own triggers, schedules or actions. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring runs (e.g. scheduled codebase scans), custom triggers beyond PR events, independent corroboration of autonomous operation.
